info.description:
Developer Access to the Pracbill API Platform, most tasks can be performed through this.

Please ensure that you read the schema items and descriptions for each request, as some items are variable and descriptions are provided there.


Please note this documentation is a work in progress, there is also an existing documentation for the api at: 
[https://pracbill.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/UGX1/pages/8880079/API+Developer+Documentation](url)
